prework.acceptance_criteria: One BOUND-S01 copy only, preserve original, exact area coverage 1e-8m2, zero nonmanifold/boundary edges, consistent winding single component, volume residual <=1e-7m3; GLB reopen and render. Stop after one coupon; do not treat as D4 or finished asset.

audit.method: Alternate edge adjacency, 9 interior samples on every cross-chart edge, bilinear RGB atlas sampling; normalized absolute channel mean, not Delta E or a calibrated acceptance threshold.
audit.classification: HOLD seam color phase discontinuity confirmed. Do not repeat texture swatches; correct continuous 3D projection or seam bake when production authorized.

coupon.scope: BOUND-S01 isolated feasibility, de-yawed exact V64 base with V63 glyph and V65 non-through fracture; not Blender nor precision asset.
coupon.algorithm: Shapely constrained Delaunay triangulation of each projected original front triangle minus glyph/crack masks. Intersections lifted on original plane then recessed along +Y by .008/.016m; add perimeter connecting walls, shared coordinates quantized to 1e-7m. Fix normals, preserve original other faces, compare integrated projected depth-volume.
coupon.render: Actual VTK EGL two angles, original and coupon side by side; frontal cuts almost invisible, oblique cuts visible. G2 HOLD; faceted outline not matched to 2D original. No self-intersection proof or native after-cut UV.
